_help: Sponsored rounds: one round a sponsor provides inside a toy, always labelled "Sponsored round by [name]". Shown only when approved is true, For Projects is switched on, and today is between from (optional) and until. toy: a toy id from roundToys in ad_slots.json. kind 'lesson': a card in the middle of a learning toy (title, optional text, points); never part of the quiz. kind 'scam': one Spot the Scam round (scenario: same fields as data/scam-scenarios.js; it replaces one round with the same answer). Keep it educational: no token promotions, price claims or calls to buy. Book it on /advertise/ (with a sponsored round), then add it here and set approved to true.

rounds.title: Back up your wallet the right way
points: Write your recovery phrase on paper, never in a photo or a chat.
Keep it somewhere only you can reach.
No real support team will ever ask for it.

scenario.body: Hello! Your Example Wallet will be locked in 24 hours. Reply with your recovery phrase so we can verify you and keep it open.
scenario.explain: Example Wallet never messages you first and will never ask for your recovery phrase. Anyone who has it can empty your wallet. Use the in-app help only.
